files.title: The water cycle
files.author: Original artwork made for EducationalCalculator
files.license: Owned by the project; no third-party content
files.notes: Sun, ocean, mountains, a river and clouds. Arrows only: two wavy arrows up from the ocean (evaporation), a curved arrow from the white cloud to the rain cloud (condensation and cloud movement), a down arrow in the rain (precipitation), and an arrow along the land to the ocean (runoff and collection).

files.title: Weather map with fronts
files.author: Original artwork made for EducationalCalculator
files.license: Owned by the project; no third-party content
files.notes: Simplified contiguous U.S. outline. Red L in the Plains with a cold front (blue, triangles pointing east/southeast, the way it moves) running southwest and a warm front (red, half-circles pointing north) running east, which becomes a stationary front (alternating blue triangles on the south side and red half-circles on the north side). Blue H in the West. Green rain area with raindrops near the low and along the fronts. Only letters H and L.

files.title: Plate boundaries
files.author: Original artwork made for EducationalCalculator
files.license: Owned by the project; no third-party content
files.notes: Three panels, left to right. Divergent: cross-section of a mid-ocean ridge, plates moving apart, magma rising in the gap, mantle currents rising in the middle. Convergent: oceanic plate sinking (subducting) under a continental plate at a trench, magma rising to a volcano. Transform: two blocks seen from above sliding past each other, with a stream and a road offset along the fault. No words.
